div.div: مُحَوْصَلٌ (K) and مُحَوْصِلٌ, (K, TA,) or ↓ مُحْصَوْصِلٌ , (so in my MS. copy of the K,) or مُحْصَوْصِلٌ, (so in the CK,) One who is protuberant in his lower part [of the belly], next his navel, like her who is pregnant: (K:) so in the M. (TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
